train_half.role: trains the Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct verifier (same training settings as v2)
train_half.rule: v2 train split into two question-group-disjoint halves, stratified like the v2 split; positives unchanged, each negative re-drawn inside its own half with the v2 rule; validation and test are the v2 files

filters.exclude_multi_label_solutions_rule: drop every case of a solution (same dataset, question and solution after NFKC, lowercase and whitespace removal) whose pool records carry more than one normalized source label; applied before splitting

held_out_missing_information.mathclean:3fa3a27b6b350aa5: question refers to 'a more complex figure' that is not included
held_out_missing_information.mathclean:5420672e35b7999b: vertex labels B and G depend on a cube figure that is not included
held_out_missing_information.mathclean:2018d169dd6fe205: the sales graph the question refers to is not included

grouping.question_group_key: NFKC, lowercase, all whitespace and punctuation removed
grouping.duplicate_record_key: same dataset; question and solution equal after NFKC, lowercase and whitespace removal; same normalized label

split.stratify_by: dataset | benchmark | normalized source label of the group's most frequent case

negatives.candidate_rule: same dataset, same split, different normalized source label, different question group
negatives.label_normalization: NFKC, lowercase, underscores as spaces, whitespace collapsed
